info.title: MedSupply Cloud API
info.description:
REST API for the MedSupply Cloud B2B medical-supply platform (Jakarta Servlets + Supabase PostgREST).

**Authentication** is cookie/session based: call `POST /api/auth/login`, then the returned `JSESSIONID` cookie authorizes subsequent calls. All `/api/*` endpoints require a session except `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/verify` and `/api/test`.

**Roles**: `ADMIN`, `CLIENT`, `SUPPLIER`. Most responses use the envelope `{ "success": boolean, "message": string, ... }`.

tags.name: quotes
tags.description: Quote requests, admin pricing & client decisions

tags.name: clients
tags.description: Client profiles (read-only: name resolution & admin listing)

tags.name: suppliers
tags.description: Supplier profiles (read-only: name resolution & admin listing)

post.summary: Authenticate a user with email and password and create an HttpSession.
post.description:
**Public** (no authentication required).

Public per AuthFilter prefix /api/auth/login. On success sets session attributes user, userId, role and a 30-minute (30*60s) max inactive interval. Body is read line-by-line via req.getReader().readLine() then parsed with Gson into JsonObject; missing email/password fields cause a NullPointerException that is caught generically and returned as 500.

401.description: Invalid email or password (authService.login returned null - bad credentials, inactive user, or empty/blank email/password).

403.description: Email not verified (thrown exception message contains 'verify your email').

example.message: Please verify your email before logging in

500.description: Unexpected error (e.g., malformed JSON, missing email/password field NPE, Supabase error). Leaks exception message to client.

post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

NOT in the AuthFilter public-prefix list (only /api/auth/login, /api/auth/register, /api/auth/verify, /api/test are public), so AuthFilter requires an authenticated session to reach this servlet. Internally calls req.getSession(false) and null-checks it before invalidate(), so it is safe if reached. Any authenticated role may call it.

200.description: Logout successful (session invalidated if one existed).

500.description: Unexpected error during logout. Leaks exception message to client.

post.summary: Register a new user (CLIENT or SUPPLIER) with an associated profile and send a verification email.
post.description:
**Public** (no authentication required).

Public per AuthFilter prefix /api/auth/register. Role is taken from the request body (CLIENT or SUPPLIER); profile object shape depends on role. For role ADMIN (or any value other than CLIENT/SUPPLIER) no profile is parsed and profileData stays null, so only a users row is created. Body parsed with JsonParser.parseString(...).getAsJsonObject(); missing required fields (email/password/role or nested profile fields) cause a NullPointerException caught generically and returned as 500. Email already-registered also returns 500 (not 409).

201.description: Registration successful; user (and profile for CLIENT/SUPPLIER) created, verification email sent or token logged.

500.description: Registration failed for any reason: email already registered, missing/invalid body fields (NPE), Supabase error, etc. Leaks exception message to client.

get.summary: Verify a user's email address using a verification token.
get.description:
**Public** (no authentication required).

Public per AuthFilter prefix /api/auth/verify. Token supplied as query parameter. On success the user's email_verified is set true and the verification token/expiry are cleared. Invalid token, expired token, and generic verification failure all return 400.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Email verification token previously emailed to the user.

example.message: Email verified successfully. You can now login.

400.description: Missing/blank token, invalid token, expired token, or generic verify failure (verifyEmail returned false). Exception messages (e.g. 'Invalid verification token', 'Verification token has expired') are returned to the client.

get.summary: List products, optionally filtered by category, brand, or supplier (only active products are returned).
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

Only one filter is honored due to if/else-if precedence: categoryId > brandId > supplierId. Filters are not combinable. No pagination/sorting. Underlying DAO filters is_active=eq.true for all list variants.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: If non-empty, returns active products in this category. Mutually exclusive with brandId/supplierId; evaluated first.

parameters.name: brandId
parameters.description: If non-empty (and categoryId empty), returns active products for this brand.

parameters.name: supplierId
parameters.description: If non-empty (and categoryId/brandId empty), returns active products for this supplier.

200.description: List returned successfully. 'count' is the number of products.

500.description: Unexpected server error (e.g. Supabase HTTP error). Raw exception message leaked.

post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Validation errors (name/reference required, unitPrice positive) and bad-request conditions all return 500 instead of 400. Body read line-by-line then JSON parsed; missing required JSON keys cause NullPointerException caught as 500.

201.description: Product created. Returns the created product (is_active forced to true).

403.description: Caller is not authenticated as ADMIN (no session, or role != ADMIN).

500.description: Any error: missing required field (NPE), malformed JSON, invalid unitPrice, validation failure ('Unit price must be positive', etc.), or Supabase error. All collapse to 500 with leaked message.

example.message: Server error: Unit price must be positive

delete.summary: Soft-delete a product by setting is_active=false (ADMIN only).
delete.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Delete is a soft delete (PATCH is_active=false), not a hard DELETE. Service pre-checks existence via findById and throws (->500) if absent.

200.description: Product soft-deleted successfully (is_active set to false).

400.description: Missing/empty product ID in path, OR DAO.delete returned false (PATCH response body was empty).

403.description: Caller is not authenticated as ADMIN.

500.description: Product not found (service throws) or Supabase error. 'Product not found' returns 500, not 404.

get.summary: Get a single product by its UUID. Returns inactive (soft-deleted) products too.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

findById does NOT apply is_active filter, so soft-deleted products are still retrievable by direct ID even though they are hidden from list endpoints.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product UUID. Derived from @WebServlet("/api/products/*") pathInfo substring(1).

500.description: Unexpected server error (e.g. Supabase HTTP error). Raw exception message leaked.

put.summary: Update an existing product (ADMIN only).
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Updated product object is NOT returned in the 200 response (unlike POST). 'Product not found' is surfaced as 500 because the service throws an exception. is_active is never updated by DAO.update.

400.description: Missing/empty product ID in path, OR DAO.update returned false (PATCH response body was empty).

403.description: Caller is not authenticated as ADMIN.

500.description: Product not found (service throws), validation failure, malformed JSON/NPE, or Supabase error. Note: 'Product not found' returns 500, not 404.

get.summary: List quotes. CLIENT receives only their own quotes; ADMIN receives all quotes (optionally filtered by status); SUPPLIER is forbidden.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT, ADMIN**.

Role read from session.getAttribute("role"). userId used for the CLIENT filter. The 400 IllegalArgumentException branch in doGet is effectively unreachable for the collection path.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ADMIN only. Filters quotes by status (e.g. PENDING, REVIEWED, APPROVED, REJECTED, CONVERTED). Ignored for CLIENT. Passed unescaped into the PostgREST status=eq.{status} filter.

200.description: List of quotes with a count.

403.description: Caller is a SUPPLIER (no access to quotes).

500.description: DAO/Supabase error. Raw exception message leaked.

post.summary: Create a new quote request (demande de devis) with line items. Proposed prices are taken from the product catalog and the quote total is computed server-side; status is set to PENDING.
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT**.

Body parsed via req.getReader() line loop then JsonParser; items extracted from requestJson.get("items") and deserialized with Gson TypeToken<List<QuoteItem>>. Gson uses the no-arg QuoteItem constructor, so itemId is NOT generated client-side (relies on DB default for quote_items.id). Validation errors (empty items, missing product, non-positive quantity) are thrown as generic Exception and surface as HTTP 500 rather than 400.

201.description: Quote created successfully. Returns the created quote (note: total_amount on the returned object is 0/initial because updateTotalAmount runs after the create response is captured).

403.description: Caller is not a CLIENT (ADMIN/SUPPLIER blocked).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only clients can create quotes

500.description: Any failure: empty/missing items, product not found, non-positive quantity, malformed JSON body, or DAO/Supabase error. The raw exception message is leaked to the client.

get.summary: Get a single quote with its line items. CLIENT may only view their own quote; ADMIN may view any. SUPPLIER is not explicitly blocked on this branch.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

SUPPLIER is blocked on the collection branch but NOT on the single-quote branch, so an authenticated SUPPLIER can read any quote by ID. A non-existent quote yields HTTP 500 instead of 404 because QuoteService.getQuoteWithItems throws a generic Exception.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Quote ID. Matched via pathInfo regex /[^/]+ and passed unescaped into PostgREST id=eq.{id} filter.

403.description: CLIENT attempting to view a quote that is not theirs.

example.message: Unauthorized - You can only view your own quotes

400.description: Set on IllegalArgumentException ("Invalid quote ID format"). In practice not thrown by current code path.

500.description: Quote not found (service throws "Quote not found" as generic Exception -> 500, not 404) or DAO/Supabase error. Raw message leaked.

put.summary: CLIENT accepts a REVIEWED quote, transitioning its status to APPROVED.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT**.

No ownership check: any CLIENT may accept ANY quote by ID (the controller does not verify quote.clientId == session userId, unlike the GET /api/quotes/{id} branch).

200.description: Quote accepted successfully (status set to APPROVED).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only clients can accept quotes

400.description: Invalid path or acceptQuote returned false.

500.description: Quote not found, quote not in REVIEWED status, or DAO/Supabase error. Raw message leaked.

example.message: Server error: Quote can only be accepted in REVIEWED status

put.summary: CLIENT rejects a PENDING or REVIEWED quote, transitioning its status to REJECTED.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT**.

No ownership check: any CLIENT may reject ANY quote by ID. Unknown actions on PUT (e.g. /api/quotes/{id}/foo) return 400 "Invalid action".

200.description: Quote rejected successfully (status set to REJECTED).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only clients can reject quotes

400.description: Invalid path or rejectQuote returned false.

500.description: Quote not found, quote not in PENDING/REVIEWED status, or DAO/Supabase error. Raw message leaked.

example.message: Server error: Quote can only be rejected in PENDING or REVIEWED status

put.summary: ADMIN sets per-item admin prices, recomputes the quote total, and transitions the quote from PENDING to REVIEWED.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

itemPrices map deserialized with Gson TypeToken<Map<String,BigDecimal>>. Service throws generic Exception for business-rule violations (not found, wrong status, bad price) -> these surface as 500, not 400/404/409. itemId keys are passed unescaped into PostgREST id=eq.{itemId} filters via updateAdminPrice/findById.

200.description: Quote reviewed successfully (status set to REVIEWED).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can review quotes

400.description: Invalid path (pathInfo null or fewer than 3 segments), unknown action, IllegalArgumentException, or reviewQuote returned false.

500.description: Quote not found, quote not in PENDING status, non-positive admin price, malformed body, or DAO/Supabase error. Raw exception message leaked.

example.message: Server error: Quote can only be reviewed in PENDING status

get.summary: List orders. CLIENT gets only their own orders; ADMIN gets all orders (optionally filtered by status query param); SUPPLIER forbidden.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT, ADMIN**.

Selected in doGet when pathInfo is null or does not match /[^/]+ . Role/userId read from session. CLIENT path uses session userId -> findByClientId.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ADMIN only. When non-empty, filters orders by status (passed to OrderDAO.findByStatus). Ignored for CLIENT. Not validated against the allowed status set.

403.description: Caller role is SUPPLIER (or any role that is neither CLIENT nor ADMIN).

400.description: IllegalArgumentException caught (reported as 'Invalid order ID format'). Unlikely on the list path but the catch block applies.

500.description: Any other exception, including a NullPointerException if the session is null (req.getSession(false)). Raw exception message leaked.

post.summary: Convert an APPROVED quote into a new order (with order items copied from quote items). ADMIN only.
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Mapped by @WebServlet("/api/orders/*") + doPost. doPost ONLY handles the /convert/{quoteId} sub-path; any other POST path returns 400. quoteId is passed unvalidated/un-encoded into PostgREST filter 'quote_id=eq.'+quoteId and 'id=eq.'+quoteId in QuoteDAO/OrderDAO (filter-injection risk).

parameters.name: quoteId
parameters.description: UUID of the quote to convert. Extracted as pathInfo.substring("/convert/".length()).

201.description: Order created successfully from the quote. Returns the created order.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can convert quotes to orders

400.description: Path does not start with /convert/ (invalid request path), OR an IllegalArgumentException was thrown (reported as 'Invalid quote ID format').

500.description: Any other exception, including business errors thrown by OrderService.convertQuoteToOrder (e.g. 'Quote not found', 'Quote must be in APPROVED status to convert to order', 'Quote has already been converted to an order', 'Quote has no items') and Supabase HTTP errors. Raw exception message is leaked.

example.message: Server error: Quote must be in APPROVED status to convert to order

get.summary: Get a single order with its order items. CLIENT may only view their own order; ADMIN may view any; SUPPLIER is not explicitly blocked here.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT, ADMIN**.

Selected in doGet when pathInfo matches /[^/]+ . SUPPLIER is NOT blocked on this single-order path (the SUPPLIER 403 only exists on the list branch), so a SUPPLIER can read any order by id. id is concatenated unencoded into PostgREST filter 'id=eq.'+orderId (filter-injection risk).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the order. pathInfo must match regex /[^/]+ ; id = pathInfo.substring(1).

403.description: CLIENT requesting an order whose clientId does not match their session userId.

example.message: Unauthorized - You can only view your own orders

400.description: IllegalArgumentException caught (reported as 'Invalid order ID format').

500.description: Any other exception. Notably the service throws a plain Exception('Order not found') when the order does not exist, which is caught here and returned as 500 (should be 404). Also NPE if session is null. Raw message leaked.

put.summary: Update an order's status (enforces a fixed forward-only transition chain). ADMIN only.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Mapped by doPut. isValidStatus in the controller only checks the value is a known status; the actual transition legality is enforced in OrderService.isValidStatusTransition (PENDING->PROCESSING->SHIPPED->DELIVERED->COMPLETED, forward-only). An illegal-but-known status (e.g. jumping PENDING->SHIPPED) passes controller validation but throws in the service and surfaces as 500.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the order. Parsed via pathInfo.split("/") -> pathParts[1]; pathParts[2] must equal 'status'.

200.description: Status updated successfully (service confirmed a valid transition and DAO patch returned a non-empty body).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can update order status

400.description: Several cases: pathInfo null ('Invalid request path'); fewer than 3 path segments ('Invalid request path. Use /api/orders/{id}/status'); action segment not 'status' ('Invalid action...'); status value not in the allowed set ('Invalid status. Valid statuses: PENDING, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, COMPLETED'); DAO returned not-updated ('Failed to update order status'); or IllegalArgumentException ('Invalid order ID format').

example.message: Invalid status. Valid statuses: PENDING, PROCESSING, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, COMPLETED

500.description: Any other exception: service throws plain Exception('Order not found') -> 500 (should be 404); service throws Exception('Invalid status transition from X to Y') -> 500 (should be 400/409); malformed/empty JSON body or missing 'status' field causes a NullPointerException/JsonSyntaxException -> 500; NPE if session is null. Raw message leaked.

example.message: Server error: Invalid status transition from PENDING to SHIPPED

get.summary: List payments scoped by role: CLIENT sees only their own payments; ADMIN sees all payments, optionally filtered by status query param.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN, CLIENT**.

CLIENT branch calls getPaymentsByClient(userId); ADMIN branch calls getAllPayments() or getPaymentsByStatus(status). The CLIENT scoping relies on PaymentDAO.findByClientId, which builds an invalid/injection-prone PostgREST filter using a SQL subquery (see findings).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ADMIN only - filters payments by status. Ignored for CLIENT.

200.description: List of payments with a count.

403.description: Caller is a SUPPLIER (or any role other than CLIENT/ADMIN).

400.description: IllegalArgumentException mapped to 'Invalid payment ID format' (unlikely on this branch).

500.description: Service/DAO threw an Exception. Raw message leaked as 'Server error: <message>'.

post.summary: Create a payment for an order. Due date and credit terms are derived from the client's type (HOSPITAL/LABORATORY get 60-day credit, others are due immediately).
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

ADMIN-only. Request body is NOT read; amount/status/dueDate are computed in PaymentService.createPaymentForOrder from the order and client. Note: business errors such as 'Order not found' and 'Payment already exists' surface as 500 (caught by the generic Exception handler) rather than 404/409.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: UUID of the order to create a payment for. Taken from pathParts[2] of pathInfo /create/{orderId}.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can create payments

400.description: Order ID missing (pathParts.length < 3), or invalid path, or IllegalArgumentException (mapped to 'Invalid ID format').

500.description: Service threw a checked Exception (e.g. 'Order not found', 'Payment already exists for this order', 'Client not found') or any other error. The raw exception message is leaked: 'Server error: <message>'.

example.message: Server error: Payment already exists for this order

get.summary: List overdue payments (status PENDING or PARTIAL with due_date in the past). ADMIN only.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Matched first in doGet via pathInfo.equals("/overdue"). Because the literal /overdue branch is checked before the generic /{id} regex, it is unambiguous.

200.description: List of overdue payments with a count.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can view overdue payments

500.description: Service/DAO threw an Exception. Raw message leaked as 'Server error: <message>'.

get.summary: Get a single payment's details. CLIENT may only view their own payment; ADMIN (and any non-CLIENT) may view any.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

No explicit role gate, so SUPPLIER can reach this branch (unlike GET /api/payments which blocks SUPPLIER) - inconsistent authorization. The CLIENT ownership check at line 84 calls payment.getClientId().equals(userId); since mapJsonToPayment never populates clientId, getClientId() is always null and this throws NPE -> 500 for any CLIENT, so CLIENTs effectively cannot view their own payment by id. 'Payment not found' returns 500 instead of 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment UUID. pathInfo matches regex /[^/]+, id = pathInfo.substring(1).

403.description: CLIENT trying to view a payment that is not theirs.

example.message: Unauthorized - You can only view your own payments

400.description: IllegalArgumentException mapped to 'Invalid payment ID format'.

500.description: Payment not found (service throws checked Exception 'Payment not found' -> 500) or other error. Raw message leaked as 'Server error: <message>'.

put.summary: Cancel a payment. Only PENDING or PARTIAL payments may be cancelled. ADMIN only.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

ADMIN gate is applied up-front before path parsing. Business errors ('Payment not found' -> should be 404; 'cannot cancel in current status' -> should be 409/400) surface as 500.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment UUID. Taken from pathParts[1]; action pathParts[2] must equal 'cancel'.

200.description: Payment cancelled successfully (DAO update returned a non-empty response).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can cancel payments

400.description: Invalid path (null pathInfo / pathParts.length < 3), unrecognized action, IllegalArgumentException ('Invalid payment ID format'), or cancel returned false ('Failed to cancel payment').

500.description: Service threw a checked Exception (e.g. 'Payment not found', 'Payment can only be cancelled in PENDING or PARTIAL status') or other error. Raw message leaked as 'Server error: <message>'.

example.message: Server error: Payment can only be cancelled in PENDING or PARTIAL status

post.summary: Process (pay) a payment, full or partial. Partial payments are only allowed for HOSPITAL/LABORATORY clients. Updates paid amount, payment method, transaction reference and recomputes status (PARTIAL/PAID).
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT**.

CLIENT-only, but there is NO check that the payment belongs to the calling client, so any CLIENT can process any other client's payment. Body parsed with JsonParser; missing 'amount' or 'paymentMethod' keys cause a NullPointerException -> 500 (validation gap, no explicit 400). Business/validation errors all surface as 500. Because mapJsonToPayment never sets clientId, the credit lookup in PaymentService.processPayment (clientDAO.findByUserId(payment.getClientId()) with null) will fail and typically throw 'Client not found'.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Payment UUID. Taken from pathParts[1] of pathInfo /{id}/process.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only clients can process payments

400.description: Invalid request path (null pathInfo / pathParts.length < 2), unrecognized action, or IllegalArgumentException ('Invalid ID format').

500.description: Service threw a checked Exception (e.g. 'Payment not found', 'Payment cannot be processed in current status', 'Payment amount must be positive', 'Partial payments not allowed for this client type', 'Payment amount exceeds total due', 'Client not found') or a JSON/parse/NPE error. Raw message leaked as 'Server error: <message>'.

example.message: Server error: Partial payments not allowed for this client type

get.summary: List deliveries scoped by role. CLIENT gets their own deliveries; ADMIN gets all (optionally filtered by ?status). SUPPLIER is forbidden.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT, ADMIN**.

pathInfo is null. CLIENT path calls DeliveryService.getDeliveriesByClient(userId) whose DAO query (DeliveryDAO.findByClientId) uses an invalid/raw PostgREST subquery string and will likely 500. No explicit 404 path here.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ADMIN-only. When present and non-empty, filters deliveries by status (e.g. PENDING, PREPARING, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED, RECEIVED). Ignored for CLIENT.

403.description: Caller role is SUPPLIER (or any non-CLIENT/non-ADMIN role)

500.description: Server/database error (also returned, incorrectly, for any service-layer business exception). Note: leaks raw exception message.

get.summary: List active deliveries (status in PENDING, PREPARING, IN_TRANSIT), ordered by created_at asc. ADMIN only.
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Matched first in doGet by exact pathInfo '/active', so an actual delivery whose id is literally 'active' is unreachable (acceptable since ids are UUIDs).

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can view active deliveries

500.description: Server/database error. Leaks raw exception message.

post.summary: Create a delivery for an order (order must be PAID or PROCESSING and have no existing delivery). Sets status PENDING and estimated delivery date now+3 days; if order was PAID, advances order to PROCESSING. ADMIN only.
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Body is read line-by-line and parsed with JsonParser.parseString(...).getAsJsonObject(); empty or non-object body throws and becomes 500. All three body fields are optional (null-safe via .has()).

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order ID, taken from pathParts[2] after splitting pathInfo on '/'.

400.description: Order ID missing in path (pathParts.length < 3), or IllegalArgumentException (e.g. malformed body causing JsonParser failure may instead surface as 500). 'Order ID required' / 'Invalid ID format'.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can create deliveries

500.description: Business-rule failures thrown as plain Exception: 'Order not found', 'Delivery already exists for this order', 'Order is not eligible for delivery...' — all surface as 500 (should be 404/409/400). Also malformed JSON body. Leaks raw exception message.

example.message: Server error: Delivery already exists for this order

get.summary: Get a single delivery by ID. CLIENT may only view deliveries belonging to them; ADMIN may view any. (SUPPLIER is not role-checked here, so any authenticated non-CLIENT can view.)
get.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Any authenticated role.

No 404 status is ever set; a missing delivery yields HTTP 500 because DeliveryService.getDelivery throws a generic Exception. SUPPLIER role is not blocked on this single-GET branch (authorization gap relative to the documented 'SUPPLIER: no access').

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Delivery ID. Parsed via pathInfo.matches("/[^/]+"), substring(1).

403.description: CLIENT requesting a delivery whose clientId does not match their userId. NOTE: clientId is never populated from the DB (no client_id mapping), so getClientId() is null and this comparison throws NPE -> 500 instead of correct ownership behavior.

example.message: Unauthorized - You can only view your own deliveries

400.description: IllegalArgumentException (e.g. malformed id triggering an IllegalArgumentException). Generic 'Invalid delivery ID format'.

500.description: Delivery not found is thrown as a plain Exception by the service and falls through to here as 500 (should be 404). Also NPE from null clientId. Leaks raw exception message.

post.summary: Confirm receipt of a DELIVERED delivery, advancing it to RECEIVED and marking the order COMPLETED. CLIENT only.
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **CLIENT**.

AUTHORIZATION GAP: only the CLIENT role is checked; ownership is NOT verified. Any CLIENT can confirm ANY delivery by ID, including another client's delivery.

400.description: DAO reported no rows updated (updated==false), or IllegalArgumentException. 'Failed to confirm delivery receipt' / 'Invalid ID format'.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only clients can confirm delivery receipt

500.description: 'Delivery not found' or 'Delivery can only be confirmed in DELIVERED status' surface as 500. Leaks raw exception message.

example.message: Server error: Delivery can only be confirmed in DELIVERED status

put.summary: Mark an IN_TRANSIT delivery as DELIVERED with optional notes; sets actual delivery date to now and marks the order DELIVERED. ADMIN only.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Empty/malformed JSON body throws and becomes 500 even though deliveryNotes is optional, because the body is still parsed as a JSON object unconditionally.

example.deliveryNotes: Left at reception, signed by guard

400.description: Invalid path (pathParts.length < 3), DAO reported no rows updated, or IllegalArgumentException. 'Failed to mark delivery as delivered' / 'Invalid delivery ID format'.

example.message: Failed to mark delivery as delivered
Unauthorized - Only admins can update delivery details

500.description: 'Delivery not found' or 'Delivery can only be marked as delivered from IN_TRANSIT status' surface as 500. Leaks raw exception message.

example.message: Server error: Delivery can only be marked as delivered from IN_TRANSIT status

put.summary: Update delivery details (address, contact phone/person, estimated delivery date). Only allowed while delivery is PENDING or PREPARING. ADMIN only.
put.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Authorization is checked once at the top of doPut for the whole PUT verb. DateTimeParseException is a subclass of IllegalArgumentException, so a malformed estimatedDeliveryDate actually yields 400 'Invalid delivery ID format' (misleading message).

400.description: Invalid path (pathParts.length < 3), DAO reported no rows updated, or IllegalArgumentException. Various messages incl. 'Invalid request path...' and 'Failed to update delivery details' / 'Invalid delivery ID format'.

example.message: Unauthorized - Only admins can update delivery details

500.description: 'Delivery not found', 'Delivery details can only be updated in PENDING or PREPARING status', or DateTimeParseException on estimatedDeliveryDate surface as 500. Leaks raw exception message.

example.message: Server error: Delivery details can only be updated in PENDING or PREPARING status

post.summary: Update the current GPS location of an IN_TRANSIT delivery (prepared for Supabase Realtime). ADMIN only.
post.description:
Requires an authenticated session. Roles: **ADMIN**.

Route matched by pathParts.length >= 3 && 'gps'.equals(pathParts[2]).

get.summary: Health check that verifies connectivity to the Supabase backend by performing a single-row read on the users table.

**Public** (no authentication required).

Source: TestConnectionServlet. @WebServlet("/api/test") with no pathInfo parsing, so the only path is /api/test. Only doGet is implemented; POST/PUT/DELETE fall through to the default HttpServlet 405. AuthFilter treats /api/test as a public prefix, so this endpoint is reachable without a session. Content-Type application/json and charset UTF-8 are set before writing.

200.description: Supabase connection succeeded (a GET on users?limit=1 returned without error). NOTE: the response uses a NON-STANDARD envelope (status/message/base_de_donnees) instead of the global {success,message,...} standard. The parsed JsonArray result is fetched but never used in the body.

500.description: Supabase request failed or any exception was thrown. The raw exception message (e.getMessage()) is interpolated UNESCAPED into the JSON, which leaks internal/Supabase error detail and can produce malformed JSON if the message contains quotes or newlines. Envelope is non-standard (status/message).
